item.title: Chaining GitHub Actions Workflows Without a PAT or GitHub App
item.description: Chaining GitHub Actions Workflows Without a PAT or GitHub App How to trigger one workflow from another when you can’t (or don’t want to) use Personal Access Tokens or GitHub Apps. The Problem You have two workflows: Workflow A — Detects branches and auto-creates PRs against main Workflow B — Runs tests on PRs opened against main Manual PRs trigger Workflow B. But when Workflow A creates a PR, Workflow B never runs.
